GEN.1.1.text: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.

PSA.118.24.text: This is the day that the LORD has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!

PSA.119.11.text: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.

PSA.119.105.text: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.

PSA.119.130.text: The entrance of your words gives light. It gives understanding to the simple.

PRO.3.5.text: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.

PRO.16.3.text: Commit your deeds to the LORD, and your plans shall succeed.

PRO.18.10.text: The LORD’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.

PRO.22.6.text: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.

ISA.26.3.text: You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.

MAT.5.9.text: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.

MAT.6.33.text: But seek first God’s Kingdom and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.

MAT.5.16.text: Even so, let your light shine before men, that they may see your good works and glorify your Father who is in heaven.

ROM.8.28.text: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.

ROM.12.2.text: Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.

2TI.1.7.text: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.

HEB.11.1.text: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.

ROM.5.8.text: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

LAM.3.22.text: It is because of the LORD’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail.

MIC.6.8.text: He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does the LORD require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?

JOH.1.1.text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

JOH.3.16.text: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only born Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

JOH.8.12.text: Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”

JOH.10.10.text: The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.

JOH.14.27.text: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.

JOH.15.5.text: I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me and I in him bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.

JAM.1.5.text: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.

1JO.4.19.text: We love him, because he first loved us.

PHI.4.13.text: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.

1CO.15.58.text: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord’s work, because you know that your labor is not in vain in the Lord.
